description: Source code for managing background DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) operations in radio channels, including starting, stopping, notifications, and configuration updates.

methods.name: s_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the current radio configuration (channel and bandwidth) into a transaction.

methods.name: s_writeStatistics
methods.description: Writes background DFS statistics into a transaction for a specific radio.

methods.name: s_writeStatus
methods.description: Writes the current background DFS status into a transaction.

methods.name: s_resetStatus
methods.description: Resets the DFS status based on enable and available flags.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearStarted
methods.description: Notifies that a background DFS clear operation has started on a specific channel.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the background DFS process is currently active.

methods.name: s_sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification on the bus that a DFS clear operation has completed.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_clearTimeEllapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the DFS clear operation started.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearEnded
methods.description: Handles the end of a DFS clear operation, updates stats, and sends notifications.

methods.name: s_checkEnableChange
methods.description: Checks and handles changes in enable state, stopping DFS if disabled.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_setAvailable
methods.description: Sets the availability of background DFS and updates status accordingly.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_update
methods.description: Updates the background DFS configuration in the system.

methods.name: bgdfs_startClear
methods.description: Starts a background DFS clear operation on a specified channel and bandwidth.

methods.name: bgdfs_stopClear
methods.description: Stops an ongoing background DFS clear operation.

methods.name: _wld_radBgDfs_setConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles configuration updates for background DFS via local DM signals.

methods.name: _startBgDfsClear
methods.description: Wrapper function to initiate background DFS clear via external call.

methods.name: _stopBgDfsClear
methods.description: Wrapper function to stop background DFS clear via external call.
